summary: A Yes vote enacts a City of Chino Hills transactions and use (sales) tax.

tax.text: A Yes vote enacts an additional local sales tax of 1% to generate funds for local services and infrastructure.
tax.quote: If voters approve Measure J, it is expected to generate approximately $11.5 million each year in additional dedicated and locally controlled funds.

tax.text: A No vote does not enact the additional 1% local sales tax proposed by Measure J.
